title: Heavy duty but don't stay sealed
text: Heavy duty but don't stay sealed. Out of the four bags I have used so far only one has remained sealed. They come folded so the opening of the bags have a crease in them. They seal up like a zip lock baggie. I believe the crease is where the air is seeping back in. Going to try using a heat pack and weight on that area to try to eliminate the crease problem. They are very sturdy so don't have to worry about tearing them.
